items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1971-04-08
items.q: The name 'Dick' appears twice in the transcript, but in both instances, it is used as a form of address to the interviewer (e.g., 'That big yard, great big yard, Dick.' and 'No but I'll tell you Dick got all this down'). ctx.x: What'd you say? What's the best audience you ever played for, the greatest time you ever had, you know, playing for people?

Well, I'm gonna tell you the truth. The biggest time I ever had, the biggest money I ever made, it happened funny. I was living in Chicago then. So, a guy come to me to make up a band to take a excursion from Chicago to Memphis, Tennessee. Well, when we get in Memphis, he asked everybody, he asked them, see, how much y'all want?
